helpIntro: Illinois uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter Illinois semester hours and final grades to estimate your current or cumulative Illinois GPA and plan future grades.
helpNote: A+ and A are both 4.00. Credit/no-credit, S/U, withdrawals, and temporary grades do not receive grade points. Illinois also maintains separate transfer and overall GPAs. Repeat Impact is not automated because grade replacement requires eligibility and approval.
helpExample: A 3-hour A earns 12.00 grade points and a 4-hour B+ earns 13.32. Together, 25.32 ÷ 7 = 3.617.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ counts at 4.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A: A counts at 4.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- counts at 3.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ counts at 3.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B counts at 3.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- counts at 2.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ counts at 2.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C counts at 2.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- counts at 1.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ counts at 1.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D counts at 1.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- counts at 0.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F counts at 0.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.PZ: Pass COVID notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until a final grade is recorded.

specialTypes.name: Illinois course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter Illinois semester hours and the final transcript grade.

specialTypes.name: Transfer coursework / overall GPA
specialTypes.note: Illinois reports separate Illinois, transfer, and overall GPAs. Use official transfer grades and records rather than mixing them into the Illinois-only estimate.

specialTypes.name: Law, Medicine, or Veterinary Medicine record
specialTypes.note: Professional programs are outside the standard undergraduate record and need their own rules.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is not automated for Illinois. If grade replacement was officially approved and successfully completed, use the GPA shown on your Illinois record; otherwise ordinary repeats generally count both grades.
